verdict: curriculum_v2 repairs most review_v1 defects, including subject containment, missing analytical preparation and randomized-design coverage, the updating and relationship probes, scientific-computation leakage, econometric decomposition, and top-level visualization synthesis. It is not yet non-blocking: five new or incompletely repaired composite leaves fail mutual confidence, and c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report regresses into a concatenated prerequisite exercise rather than a report-writing probe supplied with completed analysis.
blocking_findings: Mutual confidence remains blocking in c07.data-foundations.preparation.table-transformation, c07.data-foundations.preparation.integration-reshape, c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.randomized-design, c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics.longitudinal, and c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics.survival. Exact counterexample pairs are recorded under mutual_confidence_findings.

Generation and progression: both probes for c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report require the learner to perform raw-data EDA, construct charts, and calibrate claims before writing. Report writing is a transformation/documentation capability, so the probes must supply the completed analysis, measurements, charts, and uncertainty. The current probes concatenate three prerequisite deliverables and therefore do not isolate report-writing behavior.

Prerequisite continuity is blocking on the three edges into c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report: c07.data-foundations.eda, c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.chart-design, and c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims. A learner unable to produce those artifacts can still write the report when a completed analysis, charts, and calibrated findings are supplied; these are pipeline inputs, not necessary capability dependencies.
mutual_confidence_findings: c07.data-foundations.preparation.table-transformation fails the composite-leaf test: success normalizing mixed-format dates, units, and category labels and removing exact duplicates does not predict choosing a defensible treatment for informative missingness or deriving cohort-relative exposure variables. These require distinct semantic judgments and sampling contracts; split normalization/row repair from missing-value and feature construction, or narrow the leaf.

c07.data-foundations.preparation.integration-reshape fails the composite-leaf test: diagnosing a many-to-many join and reconciling duplicated totals does not predict converting repeated monthly columns to a keyed long representation and back without changing grain. Join-cardinality reconciliation and pivot semantics are distinct central operations; separate integration/aggregation from reshaping.

c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.randomized-design fails the composite-leaf test: choosing cluster assignment to contain interference does not predict power calculations with repeated looks, multiplicity allocation, and stopping rules. Assignment architecture and statistical operating-characteristic planning require distinct operations; split randomization/interference design from sample-size, stopping, and multiplicity planning.

c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics.longitudinal only partially repairs the former biostatistics catch-all. Mastery of a paired before-and-after biomarker comparison does not predict fitting and diagnosing an irregular repeated-measures model with time-by-treatment effects and missing follow-up. Split paired outcomes from longitudinal repeated-measures modeling.

c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics.survival remains composite: constructing Kaplan–Meier risk sets under ordinary right censoring does not predict competing-risk cumulative incidence or selecting and diagnosing proportional-hazard versus time-ratio models. Split nonparametric survival estimation from regression and competing-event analysis, unless representative tasks demonstrate transfer.

The remaining 26 leaves have defensible common operations under their stated knowledge regimes: c07.data-foundations.eda.data-quality, c07.data-foundations.eda.summaries, c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships, c07.probability-statistics.probability.events, c07.probability-statistics.probability.updating, c07.probability-statistics.probability.expectation, c07.probability-statistics.inference.sampling-distributions, c07.probability-statistics.inference.estimation, c07.probability-statistics.inference.hypothesis-tests, c07.probability-statistics.inference.moment-bounds, c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.controlled-validation, c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.ab-analysis, c07.experiments-health.population-health.epidemiology, c07.models-time.model-assessment.assumptions, c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims, c07.models-time.econometrics.estimation, c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.did, c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.iv, c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.rd, c07.models-time.forecasting.temporal-structure, c07.models-time.forecasting.predictive-modeling, c07.models-time.forecasting.evaluation, c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.chart-design, c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.infographic, c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.dashboard, and c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report. The last leaf's defect is probe construction and prerequisite modeling, not internal mutual confidence.
continuity_findings: c07.data-foundations.preparation.table-transformation -> c07.data-foundations.preparation.integration-reshape passes: the representative explicitly normalizes, recodes, handles missing values, and derives fields before integration; the entry adds one many-to-one lookup join.

c07.data-foundations.eda.summaries -> c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships passes: the representative uses distribution and group summaries before association analysis; the entry adds stratified conditioning and reversal detection.

c07.probability-statistics.probability.events -> c07.probability-statistics.probability.expectation passes: both probes construct the event probabilities used by the stopping model; the entry adds the expected trial count.

c07.probability-statistics.inference.sampling-distributions -> c07.probability-statistics.inference.estimation passes: sampling shape, bias, standard error, and effective sample size determine the interval; the entry adds confidence-interval construction.

c07.probability-statistics.inference.estimation -> c07.probability-statistics.inference.hypothesis-tests passes: the probes use the estimand, estimate, design-aware standard error, and interval; the entry adds a directional test decision.

c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.randomized-design -> c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.ab-analysis passes as written: both probes exercise units, randomization, blocking, outcomes, sample size, exposure, stopping, and multiplicity; after both prerequisites, the entry adds a guardrail-based decision.

c07.probability-statistics.inference.hypothesis-tests -> c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.ab-analysis passes: the primary estimate, interval, hypotheses, and test are performed in both dependent probes; after both prerequisites, the entry adds a guardrail-based decision.

c07.probability-statistics.inference.hypothesis-tests -> c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics.longitudinal passes: the representative performs estimation and assumption-aware testing; the entry adds paired-subject dependence.

c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships -> c07.models-time.model-assessment.assumptions passes: both probes perform distributional, stratified, nonlinear, interaction, imbalance, and artifact checks; the entry adds matching a residual pattern to a supplied failed assumption.

c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships -> c07.models-time.econometrics.estimation passes: the representative uses full exploratory relationship analysis to specify and diagnose the regression; after both prerequisites, the entry adds an economically interpreted regression coefficient.

c07.probability-statistics.inference.estimation -> c07.models-time.econometrics.estimation passes: the representative defines effects and design-aware intervals; after both prerequisites, the entry adds regression specification and coefficient interpretation.

c07.models-time.econometrics.estimation -> c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.did passes: the representative uses regression specification, interpretation, robust uncertainty, and diagnostics; the entry adds a pre-treatment trend check.

c07.models-time.econometrics.estimation -> c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.iv passes: the representative uses outcome and first-stage regression estimation and diagnostics; the entry adds first-stage instrument relevance.

c07.models-time.econometrics.estimation -> c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.rd passes: the representative uses local regression estimation and diagnostics; the entry adds a cutoff-density manipulation check.

c07.models-time.forecasting.predictive-modeling -> c07.models-time.forecasting.evaluation passes: the representative constructs leakage-free point and probabilistic forecasts with intervals before evaluation; the entry adds one rolling-origin baseline comparison.

c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.chart-design -> c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.infographic passes: both probes construct a faithful accessible chart; after both prerequisites, the entry adds headline and reading-order composition.

c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims -> c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.infographic passes: both probes calibrate the supported finding, alternatives, uncertainty, and limitations; after both prerequisites, the entry adds infographic hierarchy.

c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.chart-design -> c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.dashboard passes: both probes construct faithful monitoring charts; the entry adds a category filter with an explicit selected state.

c07.data-foundations.eda -> c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report fails: supplying the completed quality, distributional, grouped, and relationship analysis leaves the report-writing task solvable, so requiring the learner to redo EDA is pipeline concatenation rather than capability dependence.

c07.visualization-reporting.visualization.chart-design -> c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report fails: supplying completed faithful charts leaves the report-writing task solvable; chart construction is an input artifact, not a necessary report-writing outcome.

c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims -> c07.visualization-reporting.reporting.analytical-report fails: supplying calibrated findings, uncertainty, alternatives, and limitations leaves framing and writing the report intact; the dependent entry's new recommendation does not require the full prerequisite outcome.
other_findings: Prior coverage and containment blockers are substantially repaired. c07.data-foundations.preparation now covers ordinary analytical wrangling; c07.experiments-health.experimental-design.randomized-design covers assignment, power, exposure, stopping, and multiplicity; arbitrary schema serialization and specialized scientific visualization were removed; c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims now excludes generic philosophy; and c07.models-time.model-assessment.assumptions supplies the model assumptions instead of demanding specialist physics recall.

The relationship and updating probe defects are repaired: c07.data-foundations.eda.relationships now adds stratified conditioning beyond summaries, and c07.probability-statistics.probability.updating uses an explicitly imperfect test with a prior, sensitivity, and false-positive rate.

The former identification catch-all is successfully decomposed into c07.models-time.econometrics.identification.did, .iv, and .rd. The top visualization synthesis is also repaired: c07.visualization-reporting now uses one completed retention analysis and one management decision across the visual summary, dashboard, and report.

All 18 internal nodes were checked. Their representative probes use a shared dataset, process, cohort, policy question, time series, message, or decision rather than unrelated deliverables: c07.data-foundations, c07.data-foundations.preparation, c07.data-foundations.eda, c07.probability-statistics, c07.probability-statistics.probability, c07.probability-statistics.inference, c07.experiments-health, c07.experiments-health.experimental-design, c07.experiments-health.population-health, c07.experiments-health.population-health.biostatistics, c07.models-time, c07.models-time.model-assessment, c07.models-time.econometrics, c07.models-time.econometrics.identification, c07.models-time.forecasting, c07.visualization-reporting, c07.visualization-reporting.visualization, and c07.visualization-reporting.reporting. No internal-node synthesis defect remains.

All 16 discovery tasks were accounted for. c07-d02, c07-d06, c07-d07, c07-d10, c07-d13, and c07-d14 directly support hypothesis testing, expectation, updating, moment bounds, controlled validation, and repeated events. c07-d01 and c07-d05 require specialist physics knowledge excluded by c07.models-time.model-assessment.assumptions; c07-d11 is generic philosophy excluded by c07.models-time.model-assessment.evidence-claims; c07-d15 is scientific computation excluded from c07.visualization-reporting; c07-d04, c07-d08, c07-d12, and c07-d16 are arbitrary schema serialization; c07-d03 is optics; and c07-d09 is sequence analysis. Those nine are routing non-members, not missing C07 coverage.

Held-out evidence remains sparse and must not be treated as success. eval-02 directly probes c07.data-foundations.eda.summaries, eval-09 probes c07.models-time.forecasting.temporal-structure, and eval-10 probes c07.probability-statistics.inference.hypothesis-tests. eval-05 is primarily C01 collection manipulation despite using row sums. Every other C07 leaf lacks direct applicable held-out evidence, so its evaluation support is insufficient rather than positive.
All 49 section IDs are unique, every parent and prerequisite resolves, and every section has exactly one entry and one representative probe.
